title: LLM accuracy GPU test fails — Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8 metric drop exceeds threshold

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy iGPU tests / LLM accuracy GPU tests
ci/gha_overall_status_ubuntu_24
failed_jobs.symptom: Downstream aggregate status check failed because the LLM accuracy GPU job failed

key_errors:
File "/__w/openvino/openvino/tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py", line 258, in test_accuracy_conformance
    assert metric_drop <= threshold, f"Metric drop {metric_drop} exceeds threshold {threshold}"
AssertionError: Metric drop 0.03294575214385986 exceeds threshold 0.03
assert np.float32(0.032945752) <= 0.03
root_cause: The Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8 GPU accuracy conformance test compares a WWB-computed similarity/accuracy metric against a fixed 0.03 drop threshold. The measured drop (0.0329) is only marginally over the threshold, consistent with normal run-to-run numerical noise (GPU kernel nondeterminism, quantization calibration sampling) rather than a code defect introduced by this PR. The PR under investigation (#38293) only touches src/plugins/intel_npu/src/plugin/src/{compiled_model_property_manager,plugin_property_manager}.cpp (NPU plugin property handling), which is unrelated to the GPU LLM weight-compression/accuracy path exercised by this test, further supporting a pre-existing flaky test rather than a regression caused by this change. This exact signature (same model/dtype/device, same threshold assertion) has recurred 5 times in the last month across unrelated PRs, per repo-memory pattern 47caedf70a4041f8.
reproduction_steps: Run locally with GPU: `python3 -m pytest tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py -k GPU --tb native --log-cli-level ERROR` (requires HF cache and an Intel GPU); the specific case is `test_accuracy_conformance[Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8-GPU]`. The failure may not reproduce on every run given its borderline/flaky nature.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed job; this is very likely a transient/flaky threshold breach unrelated to the PR's NPU-only changes.

If this Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8-GPU case keeps recurring (5th time in the pattern database), file a tracking ticket to review/relax the 0.03 drop threshold or stabilize the reference metric for this specific model/device/dtype combination.
Consider adding a small tolerance margin or averaging over multiple runs for this specific conformance case to reduce false failures blocking unrelated merge-queue PRs.
prevention_strategies: Track flaky accuracy-conformance cases in a dedicated allowlist with automatic retry, or tighten the metric computation (e.g., fixed seeds, deterministic GPU kernels) so the 0.03 threshold is not repeatedly breached by noise alone.
historical_context: Same failure signature (Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8-GPU metric drop exceeding 0.03) recorded 5 prior times between 2026-08-27 and 2026-09-16 across unrelated PRs (#37637, #37178, #37799, #37768, #37611), all categorized as Flaky Test. This is now the 6th occurrence.
